claim_under_test: Install a reusable AI Skill and it can handle a department's work.
decision: The reusable-workflow capability is supported. The department-work promise is not. The animatic may teach the missing operating setup using fictional generic interfaces and must not imply autonomous accountability, unrestricted access or production readiness.

sources.title: Skills in ChatGPT
sources.current_observation: OpenAI describes Skills as reusable, shareable workflows that can contain instructions, examples, supporting resources and code. Access varies by product, plan and workspace configuration; admins govern important permissions; uploaded Skills are scanned, but OpenAI explicitly says that scan does not replace the user's own review, policies or judgement.

sources.title: Plugins in ChatGPT and Codex
sources.current_observation: OpenAI distinguishes reusable workflow guidance from apps that connect to external systems and data. Plugin capabilities inherit underlying app permissions, so packaging a workflow does not itself authorize or validate connected actions.

claim_boundaries: Do not imply that a Skill is accountable staff or a complete department workflow.
Do not imply that installation supplies trusted files, permissions, acceptance criteria, human decisions or maintenance.
Do not show or use a real account, private file, connected app, colleague, creator asset or personal information.
Recheck availability, plan, product surface, permissions and interface paths before release capture.
release_boundary: This receipt authorizes only a local narration-timed review animatic. It authorizes no public class binding, product walkthrough, creator-content reuse, release or publication.
